caption: The drawing depicts a decorative comb, which has a curved upper portion with a scalloped edge and a lower section featuring nine long, tapered teeth. The body of the comb is a translucent, light beige or ivory color, with the tips of the teeth gradually darkening to a richer, brownish hue. The upper section of the comb is ornamented with an intricate floral and foliate design, primarily in shades of brown, gold, and light orange, incorporating stylized leaves, stems, and circular flower forms. The background of the image is a plain, creamy off-white, and there are faint, irregularly shaped light brown stains or marks scattered around the comb, with no additional objects or details present in the drawing.
title: Comb
